title: Morphology and segmentation sensitivity
summary: Compare limited boundary and affix hypotheses using held-out compression or predictions.
assumptions: Apparent manuscript spaces need not be lexical boundaries.
controls: Character-shuffled controls; equal model complexity; report all tested segmentations.
limitations: A useful encoding can compress pseudotext; affixes need not encode grammar.
cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.
